sceneLibraryEnabled.label: Studio — scene library
sceneLibraryEnabled.help: Off by default. Turn this on to let the studio save an approved background (studio grey, street, festive, winter, or an approved occasion scene) to a shared library and reuse it for later garment sets without a new shoot. A scene is only ever saved from a real, approved demo frame — nothing is ever invented.

sceneLibraryDefaultPreset.label: Studio — scene library default background
sceneLibraryDefaultPreset.help: Which approved background a new scene starts from: studio grey, street, festive, or winter. You can still change it for any one scene.
